goal: Split Nuwa-style persona distillation into a reusable Hermes/core engine and a thin AstrBot command adapter.

acceptance_criteria.description: Persona Factory core builds a Nuwa-style distillation request with source mode, output targets, safety boundaries, and a six-lane research plan without depending on AstrBot.
Persona Factory core persists submitted requests outside plugin source trees and exposes status changes for human review before registration.
Hermes task payloads require source manifests, public-information disclaimers, evidence paths, review checkpoints, and bounded export targets.
Persona Factory is exposed through DC-HUB instead of a standalone AstrBot plugin; runtime data remains under data/ and reusable logic lives in dc_engines.persona_factory.
Contract coverage stays executable through a focused harness contract test.

Hermes-side Persona Factory worker callbacks evaluate the structured trigger, write review artifacts, bypass the generic agent on astrbot_task webhooks, and let the AstrBot bridge advance requests to awaiting_review before registration.
acceptance_criteria.verification: uv run pytest dc_engines/tests/test_persona_factory.py::test_build_persona_factory_worker_callback_writes_review_artifacts tests/harness/test_hermes_bridge.py::test_persona_factory_callback_advances_review_status -q && cd hermes-agent && uv run pytest tests/gateway/test_webhook_persona_factory.py -q
